cards.title: 52 playing cards · Sandbox
cards.profile: Card IDs follow the supplied manifest. Positions are numbered, with no approved spread meanings or school.
cards.noMeaning: An approved interpretation corpus is unavailable. This only tests drawing, revealing and exporting card identities.
cards.revealHint: Reveal one card or all cards. Retrying does not change the draw.
cards.complete: All cards revealed. You can export the technical record.
cards.expired: This session expired. Start a new session; an expired key cannot draw again.

numerology.title: Numerology · Sandbox
numerology.name: Full name (optional)
numerology.consent: I agree to send this input to the backend for a test calculation. My name and birth date are not stored in the database or account history.
numerology.method: Draft method: sum all digits, then reduce, preserving 11/22/33 at each step. Names use NFC, accent removal and Đ→D; A–Z only; AEIOU are vowels and Y is a consonant. This method is not expert-approved.
numerology.noMeaning: Only calculations are shown. No personality interpretation or prediction has been approved.

calendar.title: Calendar sources, version and record
calendar.method: The existing converter uses UTC+7, covering 1800–2199. Engine agreement does not replace independent calendar reference validation.
calendar.pending: Solar-term display, folk stars and task-specific date selection await sourced, approved data. No favorable-date verdict is invented.
calendar.checked: Both engines returned the same lunar date; this is a technical consistency check.
calendar.mismatch: The engines disagree. Send feedback for review before relying on this result.
calendar.source: Existing algorithm reference: Hồ Ngọc Đức; usage rights and golden reference data require validation before releasing extensions.

errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This key belongs to another configuration. Start a new session.
